Manage your accounts and their logins

Related commands:
  login

Usage:
  maildo auth [command]

Examples:
maildo auth list
maildo auth status
maildo auth refresh work --dry-run

Available Commands:
  list        List your accounts
  login       Log in to a mail account
  logout      Delete the saved login of an account
  refresh     Renew an account's saved login without asking you
  remove      Remove an account from maildo
  rename      Rename an account
  repair      Log in again when a saved login stopped working
  status      Show whether an account has a working login
  switch      Change the active account

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for auth

Global Flags:
      --config string   Path to the config file
      --dry-run         Preview changes without performing them
      --json            Output stable JSON instead of the human view
      --no-ansi         Disable all ANSI/control sequences in human output
      --no-color        Disable color in human output
      --no-pager        Never use a pager for long human output
      --no-prompt       Never block on an interactive prompt
      --quiet           Suppress non-essential output

Use "maildo auth [command] --help" for more information about a command.
